heading: Understand your crop's health.
intro: Photograph one leaf in good light. Get a disease prediction, then discuss it with your farming assistant.
formats: JPG, PNG or WebP · Maximum 10 MB
emptyHelp: A clear leaf photo helps the model. This model supports 38 conditions across 14 crop types.
uncertain: Uncertain result. Try another clear leaf photo and seek local expert confirmation.
disclaimer: A model score is not measured accuracy or a confirmed diagnosis. Unrelated images can also produce confident predictions.
privacy: Leaf photos are processed on this computer and are not saved by the app.
chatIntro: Ask about symptoms, crop care or your latest analysis. Type, or dictate and review your message before sending.
noVoice: No matching voice is installed for this language. Text chat remains available.
noRecognition: Voice input is unavailable in this browser. Try Chrome, or type your message.
speechNotice: Voice input may send audio to your browser provider. Selecting an online voice sends reply text to Microsoft for speech. No API key is used; internet is required for online voices. Language availability varies.
listening: Listening until you tap Stop. Preview:
voiceError: Voice input failed. Check microphone permission and language support, or type instead.
reference: Reference phrase: enter exactly what you plan to say
testHelp: Read the reference phrase aloud. This measures this sample only, not overall language accuracy. Lower error rates are better.
noSamples: No speech accuracy samples recorded yet.
chatError: The assistant could not respond. Please retry later; the service may be unavailable or its free quota exhausted.
imageError: Please choose a readable leaf image under 10 MB.
